$comment: Everything worth clearing an evening for, except football — football has the rest of the site. A maintained file rather than a live API: no free sports-calendar API covers this many disciplines, and the two that come close are community-run with no stability guarantee. Dates were checked against the governing bodies' own published calendars (F1, ATP, R&A, PGA, Six Nations, PDC, WST, MLB, NFL, Jockey Club, Churchill Downs, VRC) in August 2026. 'time_known: false' means the day is fixed but the start time is not published yet or varies by session — the UI shows a date instead of inventing a kickoff. Re-check each month; this file is only as good as the last time somebody looked at it.
